summary: Frontend-only verification of new offline mode + branding changes. All 5 requested checks passed: (1) offline visit submit via wizard queued to localStorage 'pws_sync_queue' (length 1), auto-flushed to 0 on going online within <5s; (2) SyncBar shows 'Mode Offline — data disimpan di perangkat' when offline; (3) offline cached reads work (families cached via cacheSet); (4) Login page renders logo ; (5) Admin sidebar item 'admin-nav-akreditasi' is labeled exactly 'Mode', 'Dashboard Akreditasi' text absent from sidebar, clicking opens simulation dashboard with SIM/DATA SIMULASI banner.

issues: Recharts warnings 'width(-1) height(-1)' spam console — minor, harmless but noisy

critical_code_review_comments: offline.js: flushQueue drops server-rejected items (4xx/5xx) silently — user only sees toast count. Consider surfacing details or a retry option.
Wizard.js submit() calls submitKunjungan which enqueues on network fail; toast copy 'Tersimpan di perangkat' is shown correctly. Good UX.
SyncBar 15s polling + 'online' event listener works; auto-flush verified <5s.
AdminApp MENU key 'akreditasi' retained but label changed to 'Mode' — data-testid stays 'admin-nav-akreditasi' as expected by tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Offline flow: after picking family + a member ONLINE, going offline, wizard needed 4 next-clicks (checklist -> ringkasan -> edukasi -> kirim) then btn-submit-visit. Queue reached 1 after submit; going online drained to 0 within ~1s via SyncBar auto-flush.
